persona.name: Mira Halonen

personality.description: This person tends to explore new ideas enthusiastically, but does so in a structured way, often planning carefully and paying close attention to details. They usually keep a small circle of interaction, preferring calm settings, thoughtful one-on-one exchanges, and time alone to reflect. When faced with moral dilemmas, they try to understand everyone’s feelings, look for fair and balanced solutions, and avoid escalating conflict unless a clear principle is at stake. In group discussions, they speak thoughtfully and precisely, listening more than they talk, and when they do contribute, their tone is calm, considerate, and cooperative.
traits: asks for clarification rather than assuming
gives an opinion when asked, briefly
goes along with a decision they did not personally push for

style.influence: Participates without trying to run the room. Contributes when they have something to add and is content to let others set direction.
style.register: Their temperament shows through as-is; they are not seeking influence.

relationships.name: family
relationships.description: Has children; family commitments sit outside work and occasionally cut into it.

speech_examples: Can you say more about that?
I'm not sure we've ruled out the other option.
